# OA Group

> OA Group (OAGroupNG) is a diversified Nigerian professional services group comprising five CAC-registered subsidiary entities operating across Accounting, Management Consulting, Real Estate, Financial Services, and Contracting. Headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria.

## About

OA Group brings together five specialist businesses under one integrated platform, enabling clients to access coordinated expertise across the full business lifecycle — from incorporation and compliance, through growth advisory, property, and financing, to project execution.

All five subsidiaries are registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) of Nigeria and operate in accordance with applicable Nigerian regulatory frameworks including FIRS, NDPR, and sector-specific bodies.

## Our Companies

- [Olusola Adekanola & Co (OA & Co)](https://olusola-adekanola.oagroupng.com): Professional accounting, audit, tax compliance, and financial reporting services. Serves SMEs, corporates, and individuals across Nigeria.
- [OA Consulting Limited](https://oaconsulting.oagroupng.com): Management advisory covering business strategy, organisational design, process optimisation, and market entry for Nigerian and West African markets.
- [Henrisol Properties Ltd](https://henrisol.oagroupng.com): Real estate development, property management, investment advisory, and facility services across residential and commercial segments.
- [Maria Oyinlola Limited (MOL)](https://mol.oagroupng.com): Financial services and microfinance — credit facilitation, investment advisory, SME financing solutions, and wealth management.
- [Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Limited](https://pearlprimus.oagroupng.com): General contracting, procurement, infrastructure, and commercial project execution across public and private sectors.
